title: Senior Manager_Oracler DBA
description:
**Who we are**
--------------


VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture**About this Role**
-------------------


We are seeking an experienced **Oracle Application DBA Lead** to join ITO in **SP Infocity, Pune**. The role requires **10 to 15 years of application database administration experience**, with hands\-on expertise across multiple Oracle database versions.
You will support operational and critical database activities while contributing to end\-to\-end service stability, availability and continual improvement. The role combines Oracle database administration, performance optimisation, automation, monitoring and observability with service governance and collaboration with application teams.
You will also contribute to **Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices and AI\-driven optimisation initiatives** across CRM and end\-to\-end operations, helping improve operational efficiency.**What you will do**
--------------------


* Administer and support production Oracle databases and associated operational activities.
* Analyse database and application performance bottlenecks, including scripts, code and user\-generated queries that may cause application slowness.
* Perform **SQL and database performance tuning** and support DML operations.
* Support database upgrades and migrations, including integrations with other RDBMS technologies.
* Apply knowledge of database architecture, memory architecture, storage architecture, clustering and high\-availability solutions.
* Manage database backup and recovery activities.Support user access management and security audits.
* Monitor and participate in auditing and **SOX compliance** activities.
* Use monitoring and observability solutions such as Enterprise Manager, Grafana, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Kibana, Splunk or Zabbix.
* Perform log analysis, alert tuning, dashboard management and proactive monitoring.
* Develop and maintain environment support and maintenance scripts to automate BAU operational activities and improve system stability.
* Use advanced UNIX skills to manage jobs and batch processes and to tune or create processes where required.Work closely with application teams to support database operations.
* Use ticketing tools to manage operational activities and incidents.Provide on\-call support for high\-priority database issues.
* Contribute to proactive monitoring, automation, reconciliation and continual service improvement.
* Support service governance and end\-to\-end service stability and availability.
* Apply SRE practices and contribute to AI\-driven optimisation initiatives across CRM and end\-to\-end operations.
**Who you are**
---------------


* You have **10 to 15 years of experience** in application database support and administration.
* You have hands\-on experience administering **Oracle databases across multiple versions**.
* You have practical expertise in **database and SQL performance tuning**.
* You understand Oracle and non\-Oracle database architecture.
* You are experienced in configuring databases and providing operational support.
* You understand memory, storage and cluster architecture as well as high\-availability approaches.
* You have advanced knowledge of **UNIX**, shell scripting and at least one scripting language, such as Perl.
* You have experience with proactive monitoring, operational automation, reconciliation and continual service improvement.
* You understand database upgrades, migrations, backup and recovery, security and user access management.
* You have experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Enterprise Manager, Grafana, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Kibana, Splunk or Zabbix.You bring analytical, communication, stakeholder\-management and technical\-leadership capabilities.
* You have a bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Telecom industry knowledge would be advantageous.ITIL certification is desirable.
**Not a Perfect Fit?**
----------------------


Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.**What’s in it for you**
------------------------


* Opportunity to work on business\-critical Oracle database environments and end\-to\-end operational services.
* Exposure to **SRE practices, AI\-driven optimisation and automation** within CRM and end\-to\-end operations.
* Opportunity to contribute to service stability, availability, proactive monitoring and continual service improvement.
* Collaboration with application and operational teams in a large\-scale telecom technology environment.
* Opportunity to apply technical\-leadership skills to complex database performance, reliability and operational challenges.
**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------


* Broader application of **SRE practices** to database operations and service reliability.
* Practical application of **AI\-driven optimisation** within CRM and end\-to\-end operations.
* Advanced operational automation and proactive database monitoring approaches.
* Enhanced observability skills covering log analysis, dashboarding and alert optimisation.
* Broader experience in continual service improvement, service governance and cross\-functional database operations.
**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------


Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.**Join Us**
-----------


At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.  

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.  

With us, you can be truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.**Alert**

Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.” \#JDEnhancedByTARA**Follow us on social media and \#StayConnected**
-------------------------------------------------

title: SAP Basis AMS Consultant
description:
Job Description
**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI\-led, platform\-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry\-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654\.4M FY26 revenue with 17\.4% Y\-o\-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436\.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3\.2% Q\-o\-Q and 16\.2% Y\-o\-Y growth. Our 27,500\+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026\.

 **About Position:**

  

We are seeking an experienced SAP Basis AMS Consultant to provide reliable Application Management Services (AMS) across production and non\-production SAP landscapes. The ideal candidate will be responsible for system monitoring, incident resolution, service request fulfillment, change implementation, technical administration, and continuous service improvement. In this role, you will work closely with SAP functional teams, database administrators, infrastructure teams, security teams, and business stakeholders to ensure system stability, availability, performance, and operational excellence. You will play a critical role in maintaining SAP environments while supporting modernization, automation, and service quality initiatives.

* **Role: SAP Basis AMS Consultant**
* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: 5 to 8 Years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**

 **What You'll Do:**

  

* Monitor SAP system availability, performance, and operational health across production and non\-production environments.
* Monitor and manage Background Jobs, Work Processes, System Dumps, Locks, Spools, Interfaces, Filesystems, Database Health, System Alerts.
* Resolve SAP Basis incidents and service requests within defined service levels.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Manage SAP user administration, role assignments, and client administration activities.
* Support transport management, transport migrations, and deployment activities.
* Execute SAP kernel upgrades, support package implementation, and technical maintenance activities.
* Administer RFC connections, printer configurations, certificates, and interface connectivity.
* Support system refreshes, client copies, and environment setup activities.
* Perform system start\-up, shutdown, patching, and maintenance operations.
* Validate backups and support disaster recovery testing exercises.
* Coordinate with database, operating system, network, security, development, and SAP functional teams.
* Manage change requests through assessment, planning, testing, approvals, execution, and validation.
* Support release management and production deployment activities.
* Maintain operational documentation, SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Participate in shift handovers and operational review meetings.
* Identify opportunities for automation, monitoring improvements, performance optimization, and service enhancement.
* Ensure compliance with operational, security, quality, and governance standards.
* Support planned maintenance windows and business\-critical activities when required.

 **Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 5 to 8 years of hands\-on SAP Basis AMS support experience.
* Strong experience supporting production and non\-production SAP landscapes.
* Expertise in SAP NetWeaver ABAP and Java administration.
* Strong knowledge of System Monitoring, Transport Management, Background Jobs, Dumps Analysis, Locks Management, Spools Administration, RFC Management, Certificate Management, Client Administration.
* Experience performing SAP technical administration activities in enterprise environments.
* Good understanding of SAP HANA administration and monitoring.
* Knowledge of database performance, health checks, and maintenance activities.
* Experience supporting backup and recovery procedures.
* Familiarity with high availability and disaster recovery concepts.
* Understanding of database connectivity and infrastructure dependencies.
* Strong experience supporting Application Management Services (AMS) environments.
* Expertise in Incident Management, Service Request Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Release Management, Knowledge Management.
* Experience working within SLA\-driven support environments.
* Strong troubleshooting and issue resolution capabilities.
* Working knowledge of operating systems, networking, and infrastructure services.
* Understanding of SAP interface connectivity and integration points.
* Experience coordinating with infrastructure and platform teams.
* Knowledge of enterprise IT operational support processes.
* Understanding of system lifecycle management activities.
* Experience planning and executing production changes.
* Knowledge of change impact assessments and risk mitigation.
* Experience supporting release implementations and deployment activities.
* Ability to maintain governance and compliance during operational changes.
* Strong documentation and validation skills.
* Strong customer\-facing communication skills.
* Experience working with distributed technical and functional teams.
* Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to stakeholders.
* Strong ownership and accountability mindset.
* Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in fast\-paced support environments.

 **Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

 **Values\-Driven, People\-Centric \& Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility\-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

 **Let’s unleash your full potential at Persistent \-** **persistent.com/careers**

 ***“Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind.”***

title: GIS Data Administrator
description:
Stantec is a global leader in sustainable engineering, architecture, and environmental consulting. The diverse perspectives of our partners and interested parties drive us to think beyond what’s previously been done on critical issues like climate change, digital transformation, and future\-proofing our cities and infrastructure. We innovate at the intersection of community, creativity, and client relationships to advance communities everywhere, so that together we can redefine what’s possible. The Stantec community unites approximately 32,000 employees working in over 450 locations across 6 continents.


Grow with the best. Join Stantec's globally connected Practice Technology Services Group (PTSG) in IT, a collaborative team responsible for delivering and managing many of the advanced technologies, resources, and vendor services that underpin project delivery across the company. Working at the intersection of business, technology, and operations, PTSG helps ensure critical digital platforms remain reliable, performant, and effectively supported for teams delivering value to clients across all business lines and regions.


Your Opportunity


This position focuses on the administration, governance, and continuous improvement of enterprise geospatial data and related Esri services. Working with authoritative datasets, enterprise geodatabases, ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, and ArcGIS Pro, you will help ensure geospatial information is secure, reliable, compliant, and effectively managed by the business throughout its lifecycle. By supporting geospatial data governance, platform administration, and operational controls, you will contribute to the quality, resilience, and long\-term sustainability of Stantec’s enterprise GIS environment.


Your Key Responsibilities


* Analyze GIS platform performance, usage patterns, and service trends to identify issues and opportunities for continuous improvement.


* Contribute to GIS data governance standards and practices, and monitor, assess, and report on compliance \- metadata, data quality, lifecycle management, access controls, and information security practices.


* Evaluate the quality, integrity, and consistency of enterprise geospatial data, with a focus on authoritative datasets and sustainable data management practices.


* Administer and support ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise, and related Esri services in accordance with established operational procedures.


* Respond to and help manage Esri\-related incidents, service requests, licensing, and administrative activities through ServiceNow in a timely and effective manner.


* Analyze, investigate, and resolve Esri software and service issues and liaise with Esri support and stakeholders as required to identify root causes and appropriate resolutions.


Your Capabilities and Credentials


* Strong knowledge of GIS principles and geospatial data management in desktop, server, and online environments.


* Strong working knowledge of ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise, and related Microsoft and SQL Server technologies – to the extent needed to fulfill this role.


* Experience with the use and management of geospatial data in file\-based and database formats.


* Understanding of GIS data governance, metadata, data quality, lifecycle management, access controls, and information security practices.


* Strong analytical, organizational, decision\-making, problem\-solving, and workload management skills.


* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently and effectively across globally distributed teams.


* Experience supporting enterprise Esri platforms and related GIS infrastructure is an asset.


* Experience leading people, service delivery activities, project teams, or technical workstreams is an asset.


* Familiarity with ServiceNow, work management platforms, reporting tools, and related technology solutions is an asset.


Bachelor's degree in Geographic Information Systems, Geography, Geomatics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.


* Minimum 5 years of practical GIS experience.


* Experience performing GIS analysis and working with diverse geospatial data types, including remote sensing products.


* Experience with GIS data backup, recovery, and resiliency practices is an asset.


Work / Environment


This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed in this role. Duties and responsibilities may change over time to meet evolving business needs.


This role is part of a globally distributed team supporting enterprise technology services across Stantec's business. Success in the position requires effective collaboration across regions, time zones, and service areas, with occasional flexibility needed to support service transitions, operational priorities, and critical business activities.


Why Join Us?


As part of PTSG, you will have the opportunity to influence how enterprise GIS data, Esri technologies, and operational services are governed, supported, and delivered across a global organization. From strengthening geospatial data governance, quality practices, and operational support, this role offers the chance to contribute to technology services with broad organizational impact.


Join a collaborative team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth while helping deliver the digital capabilities that power Stantec's global business.

**Employee Status:** Regular


**Management Level:** Individual contributor

**Travel:** No

title: Database Administrator - Pune
description:
**Database Administrator**
==========================

#### **Who we are:**


Centiro is a Swedish software company with 650\+ colleagues. Our solutions empower marquee brands and finer supply chains in 175\+ countries. We believe in enabling and empowering commerce for companies with winning aspirations who seek to make a difference. Core focus is to connect and enable cloud\-based delivery and service networks in the world of digital. Centiro has received numerous awards and honors, including Great Place to Work Legend and Sweden's No. 1 Workplace in the Large Organizations category for 2021\. Founded in 1998, with offices in Sweden, India, the UK, and the US.


To know more about us, please visit www.centiro.com


Purpose – Always with our culture at heart

#### **Role Overview:**

* As a Database administrator, you will have overall responsibility for our databases infrastructure.
* Centiro has a flat organization with short decision\-making ways where you as a coworker can influence your everyday life.
* You will be part of a team with mixed skills whose responsibility is daily operation, problem solving, analysis and design.
* Your role as database administrator will be central to the operation of our systems.
* Having experience of infrastructure management and managing servers in on\-prem Data Centers, Azure and Google and able to manage \& patch the servers and troubleshoot as and when required would be an added advantage.

#### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Performance optimization and trend analysis.
* Daily operations and manage existing databases
* Maintain and develop routines for operating database servers
* Manage updates to new versions of SQL Server and MongoDB
* Automate existing routines for more efficient management
* Manage database permissions and security aspects of database management
* Investigate and resolve database related issues/problems
* Manage high availability, RTO/RPO and retention of data

#### **Who are you?**

* We are looking for a talent with at least 4 years of technical experience and experience in SQL Server \& MongoDB Server, with knowledge about:


o Windows clusters, availability groups and log shipping, installation, upgrading, and migrating


SQL Server


o Indexing, index management, statistics, integrity checks, configuration, and patching


o Windows \& Linux Server, SQL Server \& MongoDB, and the Transact\-SQL query language


o Working experience on MongoDB (mandatory)


o Working knowledge on Devops (preferred)


o Working knowledge on Cloud \- Azure, Google cloud (mandatory)


o Working knowledge on Backup and Restore methodology \- Database \+ Server (mandatory)


o Proactive with analysing database environment health utilizing monitoring tools


o Query tuning \& performance optimization (preferred)


o Work closely with developers and assist them with providing query tuning recommendations


o Ability to create scripts in PowerShell or other language


o Experience with virtualization platforms, e.g. Hyper\-V and/or VMware is a plus.


o Experience in managing infrastructure on Azure \& Google is a plus.

#### **Soft Skills \& Values**

* As we work globally, it is important that you can shift focus quickly. It is also of the utmost importance that you master English in both speech and writing.
* To be successful in the role, you work structured and proactively, and at the same time you are security aware.
* We believe that you are motivated by taking new challenges and have the ability breaking them into smaller parts to create innovative solutions.
* You understand the importance of teamwork.
* We are looking for applicants who are committed to further develop existing routines and technical solutions.
* The solutions must work optimally in their context, even when these are constantly changing.
